verdict.rationale: The registry's own document list includes a "Mass change registered agent (PDF)" form, which is a first-party bulk operation across many entities. It appears to be a paper/PDF process covering only one kind of change, with no documented programmatic or AI-driven bulk tooling. Bulk data access through data.colorado.gov runs on the separate Socrata open-data platform and is read-only, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented scope and process of the mass-change filing, bulk operations beyond registered-agent changes, a programmatic or API-driven bulk filing interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
